limits: Early-year presence is over-counted: in Toshka 2017 only 64% of fields we mark present are in the external inventory. Use the inventory's 241 for 2017.
Ground truth was labeled by an independent agent, not a person; it was consulted six times as totals only.
Toshka: half-planted fields are sometimes fitted to the planted half; faint brown or bare fields are missed; about a third of radii are 6–10% small.
Fallow and ghost circles are under-counted, so abandonment is under-stated.
Earlier epochs use one scene each and cover about 82% of the Toshka tile; 534 Toshka fields have no history before 2025.
State classes come from March NDVI only; one date per year does not separate a fallow season from abandonment.
Coverage is two Sentinel-2 tiles. Nothing here is a planetary count.
